name: Ria
message: 「I'll give you a nice massage later, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! What kind of tools are these~~?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, these are called a pestle and mortar.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh! Those are the things for going *pitter-patter* on the mochi, right!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, that looks like so much fun~」

name: Ria
message: 「Making pork miso soup sounds pretty fun too, don't you think?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it does! I get to chop lots of things with a kitchen knife, so I'm super excited~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Make sure you don't cut your fingers, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure you don't eat Tontoro, alright?」
Mochi, pork miso soup, oden, and rice balls.
We're doing the prep work for the meals we'll serve to the volunteers and guests at headquarters on the day of the event.

name: Ria
message: 「We've got the glutinous rice ready, and the water's good to go too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I was really surprised you actually own a mortar and pestle.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. It's only natural for a Japanese sweets lover!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hoho... Impressive as ever, Ria-chan. A 5-sho high-grade zelkova mortar handcrafted by a master artisan--that's some seriously fine stuff.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to tell me how much it cost.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It costs enough for Synn-sama to live off of without working for the rest of his life.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You think you could survive off that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, shall we start by washing the glutinous rice?」
We move over to the sink and empty the glutinous rice into a bowl.

name: Ria
message: 「I hope everyone eats lots and lots~~」
Since the amount is extraordinary, the two of us decide to split the work.

name: Ria
message: 「No, no! You have to change the water right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「The water's still getting cloudy, though. If I don't keep scrubbing, the bran won't come off...」

name: Ria
message: 「The bran you just washed off will get absorbed right back in along with the water, you know. That's why at first, you don't scrub the rice--you just rinse it.」

name: Ria
message: 「When changing the water, do it swiftly, briskly, and cleanly, okay?\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Man, I've always been doing it until the water turned the exact same color as the rice.」

name: Ria
message: 「I kinda get where you're coming from, though. I used to wash it until the water ran clear, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Happens to the best of us. Washing it too much is a problem too, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「We want to keep plenty of the nutrients, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「If you want to make it taste good, you do it like this--」
Ria-senpai suddenly stepped behind me and firmly grabbed my arms.

name: Ria
message: 「You're a boy, so put some more strength into it. You've gotta do it boldly, briskly, and efficiently.」
Ria-senpai really has a habit of jumping straight into hands-on coaching....

name: Ria
message: 「Like this--kneading and rubbing it together, scrubbing away.\s04」
Ria-senpai's damp, soft skin pressed against mine.

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, make a little more noise while you do it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you're already out of breath... Just a little more, so hang in there.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm gonna rinse out... the white stuff, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「There, all done! Well, did you get the hang of it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Now I've got it down pat!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then next up is the pestle and mortar.」

name: Ria
message: 「Pestle and mortar--kine and usu. Shortened to?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're using these tomorrow, right? Wonder what we're supposed to do with them.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, first let's fill the mortar with water.」

name: Ria
message: 「And then we stick the pestle right in there too--」

name: Synn
message: 「All done... Are we going to play in the water or something?」

name: Ria
message: 「No! Soaking them in water beforehand like this keeps the wood from cracking and stops mochi from getting stuck in the scratches!」

name: Ria
message: 「Making it sound like some kind of kids' game~~ For a naughty boy like you--」

name: Ria
message: 「Take some more~~!! If you're mad about it, come get me~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Grr, are you sure you want to say that? If your uniform gets wet, it'll be a big problem...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... Could it be, Synn-kun? Do you, um... want to see?」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. In that case... should I show you?」
I fill a bowl with water from the faucet and fling it right at Senpai.
Ria-senpai runs around, skipping gracefully as she dodges.
When she does a cheerful little spin, I catch sight of something.
Hiding the head while leaving the rear exposed.
Her front was completely unscathed, yet her back is soaked through.
Her uniform clings tightly to her skin, making both her top and bottom underwear show right through while outlining the curves of her plump body...
The contours of her butt and the underwear hugging it are clearly visible, making me instinctively gulp.

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? I only took a quick peek--」
